message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I finally felt like the prepared one for once! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and power bank, and we huddled together with our phones charged and a few snacks in hand. It turned into a cozy little adventure, sharing stories by flashlight and laughing at how we used to panic during outages. It felt good to have a plan in place! What’s your favorite trick for making power outages a little brighter?
